verdict.rationale: Convex documents running its open-source backend on your own servers with the same up-to-date code as the cloud service. The GitHub repo adds Docker (recommended) or prebuilt-binary deployment, support for Postgres, SQLite, RDS, Neon and Fly.io, and a flag to disable the telemetry beacon. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment in production.
